items.definition:
a piece of grassland, especially one used for hay
The cows were grazing in the green meadow.

A person who weaves fabric
The weaver created beautiful patterns on the loom.

Spun thread used for knitting, weaving, or sewing
She knitted a scarf using soft wool yarn.

Respect and warm approval
She expressed her admiration for his courage.

A person who attacks someone or something
The police are searching for the attacker.

Courageous behavior or character
Her bravery in the face of danger was inspiring.

An informal term for a British person
My friend is a Brit who loves tea.

a sharp, curved nail on the foot of an animal or bird
The cat sharpened its claws on the scratching post.

a person whose job or task is to seek financial support for a charity or cause
The school organized a fundraiser to buy new playground equipment.

a small mechanical or electronic device or tool, especially an ingenious or novel one
He loves buying the latest tech gadgets.

an item of clothing
The store sells a wide range of garments for all ages.

a broad smile
He had a wide grin on his face after winning the race.

an untidy collection of things piled up
There was a heap of clothes on the floor.

Timber sawn into planks or boards.
We bought some lumber to build the shed.

A polite form of address for a woman.
"Can I help you, madam?" asked the shop assistant.

A small projection in the center of the breast.
The baby sucked on the bottle's nipple.

The system of pipes, tanks, and fittings for water supply and sanitation.
We had to call a plumber to fix the plumbing.

A plant with bright red, orange, or yellow flowers.
Red poppies grew in the field.

A measure taken in advance to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant.
We took every precaution to ensure safety.

a tropical cyclone occurring in the region of the Philippines or the China Sea
A strong typhoon is expected to hit the coast.

the act of vaccinating or being vaccinated
Vaccination is crucial for public health.

a rapid back-and-forth movement
We felt a strong vibration from the earthquake.

a person or company that advertises
The advertiser paid a lot for the prime-time slot.

a person who announces something, especially on radio or television
The announcer read the news headlines.

a black carbonaceous material obtained by heating wood or other organic substances in the absence of air
We used charcoal to light the barbecue.

a type of fruit including oranges, lemons, and grapefruits
Oranges are a type of citrus fruit.

a room in which a court of law is held
The lawyer presented his case in the courtroom.

a dormitory, especially at a college or university
My sister lives in the college dorm.

a small drop of a liquid
There's a constant drip from the leaky faucet.

one of several payments
She paid for the car in monthly installments.

a child whose parents are dead
The story is about a young orphan who finds a new home.

a flat, round piece of ground meat or other food
I ordered a hamburger with an extra patty.

a place by the sea
We spent our summer vacation at the seaside.

a set of stairs
The old house had a grand wooden staircase.

tango (a dance)
They learned to dance the tango at the club.

brightness
You can adjust the brightness of the screen.

cigar
He lit a large cigar after dinner.

cologne (perfume for men)
He put on some cologne before going out.

a person or team that takes part in the final of a competition
She was a finalist in the national spelling bee.

a pig, especially a castrated male pig raised for meat; to take or use a disproportionate share of something
He tends to hog the remote control.

a person who owns a house
The homeowner is responsible for maintaining the property.

preserved dead body; mother (UK informal)
Ancient Egyptians preserved bodies as mummies.

area of fruit trees
We picked apples in the old orchard.

rhinoceros
We saw a rhino at the zoo.

aromatic herb
Rosemary is often used to flavor roasted potatoes.

a term of endearment
Come here, sweetie, and give me a hug.

a young person
The youngsters enjoyed playing in the park.

a transparent tank of water for fish
We visited the large aquarium at the zoo.

a sense of being accepted; possessions
She felt a strong sense of belonging in the new community.

a fertile spot in a desert where water is found
The travelers were relieved to find an oasis after days in the desert.

the outer parts of a town or city
They live on the outskirts of the city, where it's quieter.

a white vitrified translucent ceramic
The antique vase was made of delicate porcelain.

a person who writes computer programs
My brother works as a software programmer for a tech company.

a device that scans documents or objects to produce an image or data
I used the scanner to digitize the old photographs.

the quality of being serious or solemn
He understood the seriousness of the situation.

a substance diffused or suspended in the air, especially one normally liquid or solid
Water vapor rises from the hot spring.

a part of a town or city adjoining a body of water, especially a port area
We enjoyed a walk along the waterfront.

a person one knows slightly
She is an old acquaintance from college.

a person who attends a meeting or event
Each attendee received a free gift bag.

a vertical pipe for smoke or gases
Smoke rose from the chimney of the old house.

a car with a roof that can be folded back or removed
He bought a red convertible for the summer.

the action of pausing before saying or doing something
After a moment of hesitation, she agreed to help.

a tower or other structure containing a powerful light, built on a coast or island to guide ships
The lighthouse guided the ships safely to shore.

a streak of light in the night sky caused by a small body of matter entering the earth's atmosphere
We saw a bright meteor streak across the sky last night.
